class.name: WorldCaves
class.brief_description: The karst contract: where surface streams sink into caves and where the water comes out as springs.
class.description: A cave producer ([code]CaveNetwork3D[/code]) lists its swallets (stream sinks) and resurgences (karst springs). The rivers ([code]TerrainGenerator3D.get_rivers[/code] with karst on) end at a swallet when the stream carries no more than the swallet's capacity, and start again at the resurgence it feeds, carrying the sunk water (after the lag) plus the spring's base flow. With no producer both lists are empty. Get it from [WorldContracts]; a test extends it in a script and sets it with [method WorldContracts.set_caves].

method.name: _get_resurgences
method.description: Override in a stub to replace [method get_resurgences].

method.name: _get_swallets
method.description: Override in a stub to replace [method get_swallets].

method.name: get_resurgences
method.description: The springs in the world xz rectangle, each a Dictionary: [code]id[/code] (unique), [code]position[/code] (the spring pool's surface at the cave mouth), [code]direction[/code] (horizontal unit vector the water leaves by) and [code]base_flow[/code] (m3/s of its own, all year).

method.name: get_swallets
method.description: The stream sinks in the world xz rectangle, each a Dictionary: [code]position[/code] (on the channel bed), [code]capacity[/code] (m3/s it takes; more runs on down the valley), [code]resurgence[/code] (id of the spring it feeds, -1 unknown or beyond the map), [code]lag_days[/code] and [code]id[/code].

method.name: has_provider
method.description: True when a cave producer is registered or a script stub is set.

method.name: notify_karst_changed
method.description: A producer reports its sinks or springs changed within a world xz rectangle: emits [signal karst_changed].

signal.name: karst_changed
signal.description: Sinks or springs changed within the rectangle; the rivers there are laid again. Never emitted for a river rebuild.
